$comment: Machine-readable Loveland Living Planet Aquarium (LLPA) brand tokens. Source of truth: guides/LLPA Style Guide (2026).pdf, Version 1.0, March 2026. Use these exact values for any digital application (web, email, slides, app UI).

brand.name: Loveland Living Planet Aquarium
brand.mission: We inspire people to Explore, Discover, and Learn about Earth's diverse ecosystems.
brand.vision: We strive to foster stewardship for the environment and life on Earth.
brand.address: 12033 South Lone Peak Parkway, Draper, UT 84020

deepBlue.note: Reserved primarily for backgrounds and high-contrast applications. The full-color logo with white type may appear ONLY on Deep Blue or 100% black backgrounds.

usage.body: FG URW Medium or FG URW Book
usage.presentedBy: FG URW Condensed Demi with expanded tracking

rules: Do not use compressed weights unless an application specifically requires it (they reduce legibility).
Condensed weights may be used when space is limited, but only with clear purpose.
Maintain clear hierarchy: contrast weight AND size between headline, subhead, and body.

secondary.note: Used in the logo. All-caps typeface, two weights (Regular, Bold). Display use only; use sparingly. Reserve for select headers when appropriate.

logo.primary: Vertical lockup (TALL) — use whenever space and legibility allow.
logo.secondary: Horizontal lockup (WIDE) — use when the vertical lockup is impractical or horizontal space improves legibility.

colorVariations.whiteTypeVersion: Full-color logo with white type appears ONLY on Deep Blue (#001C3C) or 100% black backgrounds. On any other dark background, use the all-white logo.

logo.clearSpace: Use the height of the bird (x) as the minimum clear space on all sides. Include the descender of the 'Q' and the trademark mark when measuring.

minimumWidth.note: Do not reduce below these widths.

logo.alignment: Align to the baseline of the wordmark, NOT the bottom of the 'Q' descender.
restrictions: Symbol-only (Wave without wordmark) requires express approval from the COO and should be used sparingly.
The wordmark must never appear on its own without the Wave.
